authority_policy.local_facts: Vox mutation intent, dispatch uncertainty, identity links, runtime epoch, checkpoints, audit and derived readiness only
authority_policy.restart_or_gap: freeze dispatch and perform full broker-authoritative unary reconciliation
authority_policy.sandbox: qualification only; sandbox deviations never define production semantics

runtime_facts.freshness_and_limitations: Returns accounts accessible to current credential. ACCOUNT_STATUS_OPEN is required for execution readiness.
runtime_facts.runtime_use: validate provider/environment/account scope and accessibility before READY

runtime_facts.freshness_and_limitations: Broker is not strictly consistent. Portfolio stream/GetPortfolio can lag order and position surfaces. Sandbox omits some returns, risk and liquidity calculations.
runtime_facts.runtime_use: authoritative portfolio/cash snapshot and reconciliation completeness

runtime_facts.freshness_and_limitations: Direct snapshot is authoritative. Pinned PositionsStreamRequest supports with_initial_positions, but restart/gap still requires unary snapshot.
runtime_facts.runtime_use: authoritative current position state and discrepancy detection

runtime_facts.freshness_and_limitations: GetOrders returns active set. OrderStateStream is faster evidence but gaps require GetOrders/GetOrderState recovery.
runtime_facts.runtime_use: active execution reconciliation and unfamiliar-order classification

runtime_facts.freshness_and_limitations: Pinned and portal contracts support broker exchange identity or original idempotency/request identity. Absence is not treated as rejection unless provider contract makes it conclusive.
Portal and pinned proto support ALL, ACTIVE, EXECUTED, CANCELED and EXPIRED with optional UTC range. Unfamiliar broker stops are preserved, never auto-canceled without Vox provenance.
runtime_facts.runtime_use: protection reconciliation and independent multi-leg resolution

runtime_facts.freshness_and_limitations: Cursor page default 100, maximum 1000. Operation id and parent id may change over time in pinned proto. Official guidance says operations can arrive after real execution and must not identify order-status changes.
runtime_facts.runtime_use: bounded history overlap and fill dedupe; execution evidence only for PostOrder/PostOrderAsync with exact logical-request or linked broker-order identity; never evidence for CancelOrder or ReplaceOrder

runtime_facts.stream_capability: sandbox endpoint accepts generated account/portfolio/position/order/operation streams subject to documented and qualified deviations
identity_or_cursor: same canonical typed identities as production
runtime_facts.freshness_and_limitations: Sandbox accounts are virtual and may disappear after inactivity; margin, risk, guarantee and liquidity calculations are absent. TradesStream missing formal ACK is qualification-only provider deviation from #10.
runtime_facts.runtime_use: credentialed qualification only; never production semantic authority

optional_for_ready.TradesStream: OrderState plus position, portfolio and operation streams provide capital-change signals; TradesStream remains optional evidence because sandbox cannot satisfy strict ACK semantics

stream_policy.disconnect_recovery: bounded exponential backoff, exact resubscription, then authoritative unary recovery for potentially missed facts
stream_policy.ack_policy: production ACK remains mandatory; pings never substitute for ACK

known_documentation_proto_differences.documentation: TradesStream is 5000..180000 ms; OrderStateStream is 1000..120000 ms
known_documentation_proto_differences.pinned_executable_contract: distinct ping fields share int32 wire type but not provider validation range
known_documentation_proto_differences.decision: validate by ExecutionStreamKind; never label a Vox restriction as provider limit

known_documentation_proto_differences.qualified_behavior: sandbox sends pings and matching trades but omits formal ACK
known_documentation_proto_differences.decision: record QUALIFIED_WITH_PROVIDER_DEVIATION only in qualification; keep production ACK strict
